feedback.description: Written before this candidate has raced: cite the earlier iteration whose result supports each claim, and state no outcome for the current candidate. Say what to change depending on what the next race shows.

requested_changes.description: One to three specific fields and values to try, each tied to evidence from an earlier race.

decision.description: Your decision on the Robot Candidate you just reviewed, always required. approve: it is raced unchanged now (your feedback is still delivered). revise: the Optimizer revises it from your feedback and you review again.
